title: Midas' Rod
description: Turns fishing into a viable way of getting RICH on gold!!!
body:
### a spigot/paper plugin that adds Midas' Rod!!

recipes:</br></br>
![Golden String recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9755625e86dae11b32631f223160b6c358439a3.png)
![Midas' Rod recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f9a7739875b21452ad2cd107421c5176114b097.png)

**the chances of fishing certain items cannot currently be changed, so this is what they are for now:**</br>
Gold ingot: 25%</br>
Goldfish (smelts into 4 gold ingots): 25%</br>
8 golden carrots: 19.8%</br>
Golden apple: 15%</br>
Gold block: 15%</br>
Enchanted golden apple: 0.2%</br>
